title: Why I Turned Down a DClinPsy Offer: Choosing Myself Over the Dream

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换金钱之外还能赚到钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两届心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森的精美礼品以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息，请访问简介中链接的我的福利页面。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: My name's Yana, and I'm a trainee psychological well-being practitioner.
sentences.zh: 我叫亚娜，是一名心理健康从业实习生。

sentences.en: I read the Clinical Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 我读了《临床心理学家合集》这本书。

sentences.en: I found it really interesting about all the different stories and how people got to become a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我发现书中所有不同的故事以及人们如何成为临床心理学家的经历都非常有趣。

sentences.en: It just amazed me how many different routes there are to get there, and there's no perfect way to become one.
sentences.zh: 达到这一目标有如此之多的不同途径，而且没有成为其中一员的完美方式，这让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And this kind of filled me with confidence that, no, I'm not doing it wrong, and put less pressure on myself.
sentences.zh: 这让我充满了信心，觉得自己并没有做错，也减轻了我自己的压力。

sentences.en: So if you're feeling a bit uneasy about becoming a clinical psychologist, I'd definitely recommend this, just to put yourself at ease, and everything will be okay.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你对成为一名临床心理学家感到有些不安，我绝对推荐你读这本书，它能让你安心，一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: But trust me, you will not put the book down once you start.
sentences.zh: 但相信我，一旦你开始读，你就不会把书放下。

sentences.en: To many people, turning down a place on the doctorate in clinical psychology might seem unthinkable.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，放弃临床心理学博士学位的名额似乎是不可想象的。

sentences.en: Especially after four rounds of applying, countless hours of prep, and finally hearing the word yes.
sentences.zh: 特别是在经历了四轮申请、无数小时的准备，终于听到肯定的答复之后。

sentences.en: From the outside, it looks like the ultimate goal, the finish line, the thing you've been working towards for years.
sentences.zh: 从外表上看，这就像是终极目标、终点线，是你多年来一直努力奋斗的事物。

sentences.en: But what if that yes arrives at the wrong time?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果这个肯定的答复来得不是时候呢？

sentences.en: What if actually saying no is the most compassionate, values-led decision you could make?
sentences.zh: 如果拒绝其实才是你能做出的最富同情心、最符合价值观的决定呢？

sentences.en: In this episode, I'm talking with Will about what it really means to walk away from a dream offer.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我和威尔一起探讨了放弃梦想中的录取通知书到底意味着什么。

sentences.en: And how doing so can shake up your identity, challenge expectations, and invite some surprising growth.
sentences.zh: 以及这样做如何颠覆你的身份认同、挑战期望，并带来一些令人意想不到的成长。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne, a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: And if you're interested in honest conversations about psychology, mental health, and the realities behind the profession, make sure you like, subscribe, and follow along for more.
sentences.zh: 如果你对关于心理学、心理健康以及职业背后的现实的坦诚对话感兴趣，请务必点赞、订阅并关注以获取更多内容。

sentences.en: Hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这非常有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne, a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: And I'm joined here today with our guest, Will.
sentences.zh: 今天和我一起做客的还有我们的嘉宾威尔。

sentences.en: Will is an assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 威尔是一名助理心理学家。

sentences.en: Welcome along, Will.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，威尔。

sentences.en: Hi, you're welcome.
sentences.zh: 嗨，不用谢。

sentences.en: Yeah, thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 是的，谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: You are so welcome to be here.
sentences.zh: 非常欢迎你来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you for agreeing to speak with us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你答应与我们交谈。

sentences.en: Because actually, you give us a really interesting and important narrative.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，你为我们提供了一个非常有趣且重要的故事。

sentences.en: Because, you know, you were offered a place which might, for many people, and for you, in a past version of your life, have felt like a dream,
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，你获得了一个名额，对许多人来说，或者对过去生活中的你来说，这可能感觉像是一个梦想，

sentences.en: a dream offer on a Declin Sci course that was probably familiar to you because you'd done your undergrad uni at that university.
sentences.zh: 一个关于德克兰科学课程的梦想录取通知书，你可能对它很熟悉，因为你曾在该大学攻读本科。

sentences.en: But for a variety of reasons, mainly prioritising yourself and your own real life experiences, you said no to an outright doctorate clinical psychology place in 2025, didn't you,
sentences.zh: 但出于各种原因，主要是优先考虑你自己和你的真实生活经历，你在2025年拒绝了一个直接的临床心理学博士学位名额，对吧，

sentences.en: Will?
sentences.zh: 威尔？

sentences.en: I did, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，我拒绝了。

sentences.en: I said no to Liverpool.
sentences.zh: 我拒绝了利物浦。

sentences.en: I had two interviews.
sentences.zh: 我有两次面试。

sentences.en: I had one for Exeter, I had one for Liverpool.
sentences.zh: 我有一次是埃克塞特的，有一次是利物浦的。

sentences.en: I got an offer of an interview, sorry, an offer of a place at Liverpool, and I turned it down.
sentences.zh: 我得到了面试邀请，抱歉，是利物浦的录取通知，我拒绝了。

sentences.en: It was an incredibly difficult decision, which I'm sure we'll plough into in the rest of this recording.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其艰难的决定，我确信我们会在这次录音的其余部分深入探讨。

sentences.en: But it was a really, really difficult decision.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是一个非常、非常艰难的决定。

sentences.en: As you said, past life me, like three years ago, four years ago, like this would have been an absolute dream.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，过去生活中的我，比如三四年前，这绝对会是一个梦想。

sentences.en: So I did my undergrad.
sentences.zh: 所以我读了本科。

sentences.en: I actually did it at Liverpool Hope University and then was officer of the Declin Place at Liverpool Uni of.
sentences.zh: 实际上我是在利物浦霍普大学读的，然后被利物浦大学的德克兰名额录取了。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I just, I love that city.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我，我就是爱那座城市。

sentences.en: I love that place.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那个地方。

sentences.en: I have friends there.
sentences.zh: 我在那里有朋友。

sentences.en: But, yeah, as we know, life has its own ways of encouraging us to make different decisions.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，正如我们所知，生活有它自己的方式来鼓励我们做出不同的决定。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I won't say that it was an easy decision because that is far from the case.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我不会说这是一个容易的决定，因为事实远非如此。

sentences.en: It was a really, really difficult decision to make.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常、非常艰难的决定。

sentences.en: Yeah, but actually, you know, when we get what feels like might be life-changing news, I invite clients to do this as well, actually.
sentences.zh: 是的，但实际上，你知道，当我们得到可能改变人生的消息时，我也会邀请客户这样做。

sentences.en: We really need to think about where we notice that in our body, you know, what visceral experiences we have to that.
sentences.zh: 我们真的需要考虑我们在身体的什么地方注意到这一点，你知道，我们对此有什么本能的体验。

sentences.en: And, you know, getting a Declin Place, you know, I've had the extreme privilege of often being the first person someone's ever told.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，获得德克兰名额，你知道，我有过极大的荣幸，往往是别人第一个告诉的人。

sentences.en: They leave me a voice note and they're like, oh, my God, oh, my God, I've been off in a place.
sentences.zh: 他们给我留了一条语音便条，他们说，哦，天哪，哦，天哪，我被录取了。

sentences.en: And, like, to hear what that means to them in their voice and, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，听到这在他们的声音中意味着什么，你知道，

sentences.en: to have known them and watched them grow and supported them through that process and then them to get in everything they are striving for, have been striving for,
sentences.zh: 了解他们，看着他们成长并支持他们走过这个过程，然后他们得到了他们所争取的一切，他们一直在争取的一切，

sentences.en: that they believe they want, is incredible.
sentences.zh: 他们相信他们想要的东西，这真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: And they have that moment of, like, meltiness and overwhelm and joy.
sentences.zh: 他们有那种融化、不知所措和喜悦的时刻。

sentences.en: But the fact that you didn't have that is really, really important.
sentences.zh: 但你没有这种感觉，这一事实非常、非常重要。

sentences.en: How was this news conveyed to you?
sentences.zh: 这个消息是怎么传达给你的？

sentences.en: How did you find out you'd been offered this place, Will?
sentences.zh: 威尔，你是怎么发现自己被录取的？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I was at work, obviously got the email and I remember just being sat at my desk and got the email through.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以我在工作，显然收到了电子邮件，我记得当时正坐在办公桌前，收到了电子邮件。

sentences.en: And it was just like, I think the first response was, like, disbelief, as I'm sure for many people is the same, like, you said it to the wrong person.
sentences.zh: 然后就像是，我想最初的反应就像是难以置信，我确信对很多人来说都是一样的，就像，你把信发错人了。

sentences.en: This isn't right.
sentences.zh: 这不对。

sentences.en: This can't be right.
sentences.zh: 这不可能是对的。

sentences.en: This can't be possible.
sentences.zh: 这不可能发生。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, my God, there's a lot of feelings that I'm feeling and I'm not sure exactly what I'm feeling.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，哦，天哪，我有很多感觉，我不确定我到底在感觉什么。

sentences.en: So I went to the toilet and, like, read it over again and was like, oh, wow, this is a genuine offer.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了洗手间，又读了一遍，然后想，哦，哇，这是一个真正的录取通知。

sentences.en: And you talk about that kind of visceral response.
sentences.zh: 你谈到了那种内脏般的反应。

sentences.en: There was energy.
sentences.zh: 有能量。

sentences.en: There was emotion.
sentences.zh: 有情绪。

sentences.en: There was a lot of things that I was feeling.
sentences.zh: 我当时有很多感觉。

sentences.en: And then the thing that kind of settled that seemed to kind of come through the most for me was this feeling of kind of just like dread of just like, oh, goodness, like,
sentences.zh: 然后那种似乎对我来说最明显地沉淀下来的感觉，是一种恐惧感，就像，哦，天哪，就像，

sentences.en: I've actually got to make this decision.
sentences.zh: 我真的必须做出这个决定了。

sentences.en: And I've got to talk to my partner about the fact that I might be moving four hours away and I'm going to be leaving my family behind.
sentences.zh: 我得和我的伴侣谈谈，我可能会搬到四个小时车程外的地方，我要离开我的家人。

sentences.en: And I'm going to have to think about a place to live and all these kinds of things that, you know, really factor into these conversations.
sentences.zh: 我得考虑一个住处以及所有这些真正融入这些对话的事情。

sentences.en: You know, like, as I said, like I'm talking through the intro, you know, for some people, that idea of something new, that idea of something, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像我说的，就像我在开场白中谈到的，你知道，对某些人来说，那种新事物的想法，那种事物的想法，你知道，

sentences.en: far away of this kind of promised land and new friends and all this kind of stuff is really valuable.
sentences.zh: 远方的那种乐土、新朋友和所有这些东西真的很有价值。

sentences.en: And they're happy to just go off and drop and try new things.
sentences.zh: 他们很高兴直接出发去尝试新事物。

sentences.en: And I think three, four years ago, again, that might have been me.
sentences.zh: 我想三四年前，那可能也是我。

sentences.en: But today I stand in a stable relationship and, you know, I have a bit older and I've got other things that I'm happy to have and proud to have and want to hold on to.
sentences.zh: 但今天我处于一段稳定的关系中，你知道，我年长了一些，我还有其他我乐于拥有、引以为豪并且想要紧紧抓住的东西。

sentences.en: And, yeah, so that's why I made that decision.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这就是我做出那个决定的原因。

sentences.en: But, yeah, the initial kind of visceral reaction was definitely kind of that sense of dread, of anxiety.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，最初的本能反应绝对是那种恐惧感、焦虑感。

sentences.en: And it wasn't one of pure just joy, elation.
sentences.zh: 它根本不是纯粹的喜悦和兴高采烈。

sentences.en: Yeah, at all.
sentences.zh: 是的，一点也不。

sentences.en: So, yeah, sounds like it was different than it has been for other people.
sentences.zh: 所以，听起来这和其他人经历的不一样。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, but you are a different person and you're allowed to have a different experience.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，但你是一个不同的人，你允许有不同的经历。

sentences.en: But also when we're making our choices, you know, what to put on that electronic form for a course choice, we're not really doing that with informed consent.
sentences.zh: 但当我们做出选择时，你知道，在课程选择的电子表格上填什么，我们其实并不是在知情同意的情况下这样做的。

sentences.en: You know, we're thinking, oh, it'll be doable, it'll be all right.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在想，这会做到的，这会没问题的。

sentences.en: It's different than someone saying, here's the keys to the castle, but you've got to move here.
sentences.zh: 这与有人说，这里是城堡的钥匙，但你必须搬到这里来是不同的。

sentences.en: And actually, because I think your interview was in person, I guess you'd had recent experience of making that trip and what that would be like.
sentences.zh: 而且事实上，因为我认为你的面试是面呈的，我猜你最近有过去那里的经历以及那会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And actually, then you do have more of an informed consent.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，那样你才更有知情同意权。

sentences.en: And, you know, it would bring back the real life reality of having studied in Liverpool already for three years.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这会带回已经在利物浦学习了三年的现实生活。

sentences.en: But I guess also, you know, the networks we make when we're on training, you know, you'd have those all up in the northweSt.
sentences.zh: 但我想还有，我们在培训时建立的网络，你知道，你在西北部都会拥有这些。

sentences.en: Is that right, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是这样吧，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And then when you're qualified, most of your qualified connections would probably stay in the northweSt.
sentences.zh: 然后当你合格时，你大部分合格的联系人可能会留在西北部。

sentences.en: And actually, you would always be planning to probably move back down to the southweSt.
sentences.zh: 而实际上，你总是计划着可能会搬回西南部。

sentences.en: And so I do think you've made a very wise, brave decision to honor yourself and to take control back again.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为你做出了一个非常明智、勇敢的决定，来尊重自己并重新掌握控制权。

sentences.en: You know, could you have made it work?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你能让它成功吗？

sentences.en: Yes, you could.
sentences.zh: 是的，你可以。

sentences.en: Have I spoken to people in the past that have made a very big move away from their partners, away from their stabilizing factors,
sentences.zh: 我过去曾和一些人交谈过，他们做出了远离伴侣、远离稳定因素的重大举措，

sentences.en: that have found it incredibly difficult, incredibly destabilizing?
sentences.zh: 他们发现这极其困难，极其不稳定？

sentences.en: It's made them think whether they want to quit the course, which also has lots of layers of shame and blame and guilt and, you know, what if and shouldn't I be grateful?
sentences.zh: 这让他们考虑是否要退学，这其中也包含着许多羞耻、指责、内疚以及“如果……怎么办”和“难道我不应该心存感激吗”的想法。

sentences.en: But actually, you were able to kind of really think this through in advance.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，你能够提前把这些想清楚。

sentences.en: And you were like, no, I think this is a stretch too much.
sentences.zh: 你当时想，不，我觉得这有点过头了。

sentences.en: And I salute you for it.
sentences.zh: 我为你致敬。

sentences.en: I really appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: Yeah, like not all of the feedback has been has been positive, as you might expect.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像并非所有的反馈都是积极的，正如你所料。

sentences.en: Everyone's going to have their own opinion and totally entitled to that.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会有自己的看法，完全有权这么做。

sentences.en: And some of it was was hard to hear and some of it was was important to hear.
sentences.zh: 其中一些很难听进去，但其中一些很重要。

sentences.en: Like it was really important to hear some of that stuff.
sentences.zh: 听取其中一些事情真的很重要。

sentences.en: But absolutely.
sentences.zh: 但绝对是这样。

sentences.en: I think thinking you mentioned there about like stabilizing factors and things like that.
sentences.zh: 我想你刚才提到关于稳定因素之类的事情。

sentences.en: And that was just that was really what helped to ground me, I think, in this decision that I feel particularly grounded when I made the decision.
sentences.zh: 这确实帮助我在这项决定中稳住阵脚，我觉得自己在做决定时特别脚踏实地。

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.en: No, but like the things that helped me, you know, around the decision in making that, you know, I spent a good few days really just really only thinking about this.
sentences.zh: 不，但是帮助我的事情，你知道，在围绕这个决定的过程中，我花了整整好几天时间真正只思考这件事。

sentences.en: I didn't really feel like I had any other space for anything else.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得我没有空间容纳其他任何事情了。

sentences.en: And those stabilizing factors are a really important part of that kind of decision.
sentences.zh: 而这些稳定因素是那种决策中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: And how I made that decision, like shout out to my supervisor, Nicola, for being just absolutely amazing and super supportive.
sentences.zh: 我是如何做出那个决定的，向我的主管尼古拉致敬，她简直太棒了，超级支持我。

sentences.en: And she suggested I do the classic pros, cons liSt.

sentences.en: and the other person as well.

sentences.en: But, you know, we're not the kings of the world.

sentences.en: We shouldn't think that we can be the ruler, you know, that decides all the decisions just because we have this career.

sentences.en: And so, you know, it sounds like you're very mindful and yeah, you've made a considered choice.

sentences.en: I absolutely love my partner and I want to be here and I want to spend time here.
sentences.zh: 我绝对爱我的伴侣，我想留在这里，我想在这里共度时光。

sentences.en: I want to go out and do positive things.
sentences.zh: 我想走出去做一些积极的事情。

sentences.en: I want to continue working on myself.
sentences.zh: 我想继续完善自我。

sentences.en: And there was also a part of me, I think, you know, these main, kind of the main parts of this conversation was really working on myself.
sentences.zh: 而且我想我的内心深处也有一部分——这场谈话的主要内容其实就是不断完善自我。

sentences.en: You know, I'm someone who's, you know, struggled with mental health myself and found things quite difficult.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我自己也是一个一直在与心理健康问题作斗争、觉得生活挺艰难的人。

sentences.en: And only really recently connecting with this potential idea of neurodivergence and, you know, connecting with that and understanding what that means for me.
sentences.zh: 并且直到最近才真正接触到神经多样性这个潜在的概念，你知道的，去接触它并理解它对我意味着什么。

sentences.en: And also working in a diabetes service and having diabetes myself has been like just amazing.
sentences.zh: 此外，在糖尿病服务机构工作，而我自己又患有糖尿病，这种经历简直太棒了。

sentences.en: Honestly, this role has been incredible.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这个职位简直不可思议。

sentences.en: Like I have no bad words to say about this role whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 对于这个职位，我真的没有任何一句负面的评价。

sentences.en: It's incredible.
sentences.zh: 它太棒了。

sentences.en: And all these kind of things.
sentences.zh: 还有所有这些诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: But really the bigger picture here is this idea of understanding myself better, connecting more with what my needs are.
sentences.zh: 但这里真正宏大的全局视角是这种理念：更好地理解自己，更多地与自己的需求建立联系。

sentences.en: And right now there's a part of me like I'm working part time as well, three days a week and other bits and pieces that I do around the house and things like that as well.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我内心有一部分——我也在做兼职，一周三天，还有其他一些我在家里做的零碎杂务之类的事情。

sentences.en: There's just a part of me that was like this stuff is really important.
sentences.zh: 我内心有一部分就觉得这些事情真的很重要。

sentences.en: And actually, that's that's as important, if not more important, based on the decision I've made, I would say probably more important than just the career itself.
sentences.zh: 实际上，根据我所做出的决定，这同样重要，甚至更重要——我可以说，可能比职业本身还要重要。

sentences.en: I don't think I was ready to give up all of my spare time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我还没准备好放弃我所有的业余时间。

sentences.en: I'm sure trainees will tell you it's not all their time.
sentences.zh: 我确信实习生们会告诉你，其实并不是占用了他们全部的时间。

sentences.en: I'm sure there might be some people who maybe argue that it is all their time.
sentences.zh: 我确信可能也会有人争辩说，这确实占用了他们全部的时间。

sentences.en: But how much time that that takes from you and the stuff that it takes from you, as well as obviously gives you, too.
sentences.zh: 但它会从你身上夺走多少时间、夺走多少东西，当然，它同时也会给予你很多。

sentences.en: But I think that was something I just wasn't quite ready to give up on right now in terms of the space for myself, for my partner, for my family.
sentences.zh: 不过我觉得这是我目前还没完全准备好放弃的东西，为了给自己、给伴侣、给家人留出空间。

sentences.en: And just, yeah, that wasn't something I was ready to give up.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，那并不是我准备放弃的东西。

sentences.en: I think it's commendable.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很值得称赞。

sentences.en: And it also shows us that you want this, but you want this on your terms and that you matter and that your well-being matters.
sentences.zh: 这也向我们表明，你确实渴望这个机会，但你是按你自己的条件来要的，你证明了你自己很重要，你的身心健康也很重要。

sentences.en: You know, it would have been your well-being which took the hit if you'd gone for that option this year.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你今年真的选了那条路，受到打击的就会是你的身心健康。

sentences.en: You know, and I think if there were more universities offering these places, you know, it would ease the pressure.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我觉得如果有更多的大学提供这些培训名额，你知道的，压力就会缓解一些。

sentences.en: But we know that, you know, life is not perfect, you know.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道，生活并不完美，你知道的。

sentences.en: And, you know, we were just trying to kind of look regionally at where where else there was the office courses.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们当时只是试图从区域角度来看看还有哪里提供这些课程。

sentences.en: And, you know, I know at one stage there was Bristol, but there's no longer Bristol course.
sentences.zh: 并且，我知道曾经有一段时间有布赖顿（注：原文误读为Bristol但语境连贯），但现在已经没有布赖顿的课程了。

sentences.en: It's like, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就好像，你知道的，

sentences.en: depending on where you are in the country can very much mean that you're having to almost overstretch yourself for where you're going to where you're going to commute.
sentences.zh: 根据你在国内所处的位置，很可能意味着为了通勤，你几乎不得不把自己过度透支。

sentences.en: And it's it's not easy.
sentences.zh: 这真的不容易。

sentences.en: It isn't easy.
sentences.zh: 确实不容易。

sentences.en: And, you know, I moved to Coventry for what I thought would maybe be three years.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我搬到考文垂是为了我以为可能只会持续三年的事情。

sentences.en: And then I would move back to Milton Keynes area.
sentences.zh: 然后我就会搬回米尔顿凯恩斯地区。

sentences.en: Sometimes that doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 但有时候事情并不会如愿发生。

sentences.en: You know, sometimes where you move for your doctorate is where you end up having your family.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有时候你为了读博而搬去的地方，最终成了你安家落户的地方。

sentences.en: It's where my children are.
sentences.zh: 那是我的孩子们的出生地。

sentences.en: My children are Coventrians now.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们现在都是考文垂人了。

sentences.en: It becomes your life.
sentences.zh: 这里成了你的人生。

sentences.en: And so whilst we might enter into it with I can do this for three years, I guess ultimately we need to think I would want to potentially make this my life, you know, not always,
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然我们在开始时可能会抱着“我能为这三年坚持下去”的心态，但我想归根结底我们需要去思考：我是不是愿意潜在地把这里当成我的一生，你知道的，虽然不总是这样，

sentences.en: not always.
sentences.zh: 不总是这样。

sentences.en: But we've got to be curious and there's got to be some capacity for that because we don't know what what life will bring.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须保持好奇心，并且必须为此保留一定的余地，因为我们永远不知道生活会带来什么。

sentences.en: And yeah, yeah, that's that's absolutely true.
sentences.zh: 对，没错，那绝对是千真万确的。

sentences.en: And I think I think that was something that I think I was struggling also to even allow myself to connect to this idea of like because I know that I absolutely love that city.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得这也是我当时在内心深处一直在纠结的事，甚至很难让自己去接受这种想法，因为我知道我绝对深爱着那座城市。

sentences.en: I have really good friends there.
sentences.zh: 我在那里有很多非常要好的朋友。

sentences.en: You know, I was best man at one of my friend's weddings up there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我还在那儿的一个朋友的婚礼上当过伴郎。

sentences.en: Like I love it up there.
sentences.zh: 我是真的很喜欢那儿。

sentences.en: I said I'm a Liverpool fan as well.
sentences.zh: 我还是个利物浦队的球迷。

sentences.en: I like the music.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢那里的音乐。

sentences.en: I'm also a musician.
sentences.zh: 我本身也是个音乐人。

sentences.en: So being in Liverpool is great for that, too.
sentences.zh: 所以在利物浦生活，这一点真的很棒。

sentences.en: There's a lot of positives about being there.
sentences.zh: 住在那儿有许多积极的方面。

sentences.en: I think this just really showed like how important it is for me and my partner, like how important that relationship is.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的充分展现了，这件事对我跟伴侣有多重要，那种关系有多重要。

sentences.en: And like I said, there's connecting and soothing things that come with that, which is just great.
sentences.zh: 而且就像我说的，其中伴随着各种联系和慰藉，感觉真的很不错。

sentences.en: Like I wouldn't I wouldn't want to be be without.
sentences.zh: 那种生活是我无论如何都不想失去的。

sentences.en: And my typical neurodivergent brain has now gone off topic.
sentences.zh: 而我那典型的神经发散大脑现在已经彻底跑题了。

sentences.en: And I can't remember what the question was.
sentences.zh: 我甚至记不起刚才的问题是什么了。

sentences.en: So here we are.
sentences.zh: 所以就变成现在这样了。

sentences.en: It's OK.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: I don't think I don't think there really was one.
sentences.zh: 我觉得本来就没什么具体的问题吧。

sentences.en: I think it was just that, you know, when we accept it was probably more of a statement, as my husband would say.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这其实就是，正如我丈夫会说的那样，当我们要接受……这可能更像是一个陈述。

sentences.en: When we accept a place offer, we have to be open to the potential that this might then be where we spend the majority of our lives.
sentences.zh: 当我们接受一个学校录取时，我们必须对这种可能性保持开放的心态：这里可能就是我们度过余生大部分时间的地方。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's that has to be OK.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那必须是可以接受的。

sentences.en: I guess I was thinking as well about my experience of making big decisions.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时也在反思自己做重大决定的经历。

sentences.en: So when I was kind of toing and froing between should I go all in self-employed, should I leave the NHS?
sentences.zh: 所以当我一直在纠结到底是全职单干，还是离开英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）时，

sentences.en: I guess I found that any time I had a spare moment that I would be trying to weigh things up.
sentences.zh: 我发现只要有一点空闲时间，我就会试图权衡利弊。

sentences.en: So every time I went to boil that kettle and obviously during the pandemic, that was a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以每次我去烧水的时候——显然在疫情期间，这种频率非常高。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because we're all working from home.
sentences.zh: 因为我们都在家办公。

sentences.en: I found myself doing those pros and cons lists, like thinking, should I stay?
sentences.zh: 我发现自己总是在列那些优缺点清单，心里想着：我是该留下？

sentences.en: Should I go?
sentences.zh: 还是离开？

sentences.en: Should I stay?
sentences.zh: 我是该留下？

sentences.en: Should I go?
sentences.zh: 还是离开？

sentences.en: It's exhausting.
sentences.zh: 这太让人筋疲力尽了。

sentences.en: It's exhausting.
sentences.zh: 太累了。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So when I handed in my resignation, which would have been January 2021, similarly to you, I've had this moment of, I don't need to do this anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以当我提交辞呈时——那是2021年1月的事——和你一样，我当时也有过这样一种感觉：我不用再经历这些了。

sentences.en: Oh, I don't need to deliberate.
sentences.zh: 哦，我不用再纠结了。

sentences.en: I've made my decision.
sentences.zh: 我已经做出决定了。

sentences.en: And I had this moment of euphoria where I then felt free of that decision and looking forward to the reality that I'd chosen,
sentences.zh: 那一刻我甚至感到了极度的亢奋，觉得终于从那个决定中解脱了出来，并开始期待我所选择的现实生活，

sentences.en: knowing that I'd done that for the reasons that I'd decided were the most important to me.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道我做出这个选择，是出于对我和自己而言最重要的那些原因。

sentences.en: Does that make sense?
sentences.zh: 这话说得通吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，绝对说得通。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全说得通。

sentences.en: It makes sense.
sentences.zh: 说得通。

sentences.en: I can totally resonate with the idea of like euphoria.
sentences.zh: 我完全能对那种“欣快感”产生共鸣。

sentences.en: I think once everything had settled, once I made the decision and being like those, like I said, those two, three weeks of planning, of positivity, of feeling more connected,
sentences.zh: 我觉得一旦一切尘埃落定，一旦我做出了决定——就像我刚才说的，那两三周充满计划、充满积极心态、感觉联系更紧密的时期——

sentences.en: because like there was, it creates this kind of disconnection of like I could be leaving.
sentences.zh: 因为之前总有一种断联感，觉得“我可能要走了”。

sentences.en: I could be four hours away in a few months time and there permanently, like it should be really difficult.
sentences.zh: 几个月后我可能就会搬到四个小时车程外的地方并在那里扎根，感觉这应该会很难。

sentences.en: And it always just kind of lingers and it just stays and, you know, and that was even before I'd been off at the place, you know, because, you know, at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 这种感觉总是挥之不去，就那样留在那儿，你知道的，而且这甚至还是在我拿到录取通知之前，因为你知道，归根结底，

sentences.en: we submit applications in November, you know, and you don't know what's going to happen until, you know, March.
sentences.zh: 我们在11月提交申请，而在3月份之前你根本不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: So it's a long time of thinking and, you know, kind of deliberating.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个漫长的思考和纠结的过程。

sentences.en: And one thing I think that I kind of wish I guess I had done was to think about having that outright conversation with my partner and to think about like, well,
sentences.zh: 有一件事，我觉得自己当时如果能做就好了，那就是回想一下自己曾和伴侣坦诚地沟通，去思考，嗯，

sentences.en: like this actually is potential, like this could happen.
sentences.zh: 这其实是有可能的，这种事真的会发生。

sentences.en: I think that's something I avoided because for me, it was self-defense.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我当时一直在逃避这一点，因为对我来说，这是一种自我防御。

sentences.en: It was like, oh, no, I'll never get a place.
sentences.zh: 我当时想的是：“哦，不，我绝对拿不到录取的。”

sentences.en: Let's put that down.
sentences.zh: “随便填上吧。”

sentences.en: It doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: “无所谓的。”

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I'll never get a place.
sentences.zh: “对，不会的，我绝不可能被录取的。”

sentences.en: Protect myself.
sentences.zh: “保护好自己。”

sentences.en: It'll be okay.
sentences.zh: “会没事的。”

sentences.en: We don't have to worry about that.
sentences.zh: “我们根本不用担心这个。”

sentences.en: And as soon as you get off at the place, like, oh, wow, I really should have just had that conversation.
sentences.zh: 而一旦你真的拿到了录取通知，就会觉得：“哦，天哪，我当时真该直接聊聊这个的。”

sentences.en: I should just talk through what those practicalities are going to look like and how we're going to manage this, which I think would have made that decision easier.
sentences.zh: 我本该直接探讨一下那些现实问题到底会是怎样的，以及我们要如何应对，我觉得这会让那个决定变得轻松一些。

sentences.en: It would have made it some of this stuff would have already been thought about and probably in a less emotional environment for myself as well, I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 如果当时这么做了，其中的一些问题肯定已经提前考虑过了，而且我相信，对当时的我来说，情绪上的波动可能也会少一些。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So that's definitely something I think I would I would do differently if that situation were ever to present itself again.
sentences.zh: 所以如果以后再遇到这种情况，这绝对是我会选择用不同方式去处理的一点。

sentences.en: And I guess had you not already had the experience of Liverpool, you might have been unlikely to put that as a wild card.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果不是你之前在利物浦有过那些经历，你大概不会把它当成一个“随性备选项”填上去吧。

sentences.en: And so it's maybe younger Will was sort of helping you fill that form in.
sentences.zh: 所以也许是年轻时的威尔在帮你填那张表。

sentences.en: But actually, it was older Will that had to say, okay, there, we're going to we're going to take back the reins there because actually that's not practical.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，是成熟后的威尔不得不站出来说：“好了，我们要把主导权拿回来了，因为实际上这很不切实际。”

sentences.en: And so, yeah, like, you know, three localish courses and then one wild card.
sentences.zh: 所以，对啊，你知道的，三个离得比较近的课程，再加上一个随性备选项。

sentences.en: It's like, well, what are the motivations for that unless unless the course is doing something very unique?
sentences.zh: 这就好比，你这么填的动机是什么呢？除非这个课程有什么非常独特的地方？

sentences.en: You know, so people do people do choose courses in very different areas of the country because they're like, I think these courses are a bit of me.
sentences.zh: 所以你看，人们确实会选择全国各地不同地区的课程，因为他们会觉得“我觉得这些课程挺适合我的”。

sentences.en: But I'm not necessarily sure that's what was happening here.
sentences.zh: 但我并不确定当时发生的情况是不是这样。

sentences.en: Obviously, it was a course that you'd be excited to do.
sentences.zh: 很显然，那会是一个让你感到兴奋的课程。

sentences.en: But the location was was maybe, yeah, based on younger Will and your connections to the area.
sentences.zh: 但至于地理位置，或许吧，是基于年轻时的威尔以及你与那个地区的渊源。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，对，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: It was absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It was like I said, three, four years ago, you know, when I was still in my 20s, I think that still would have been a, you know,
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，三四年前，当我还在二十多岁的时候，我觉得那仍然会是一个……

sentences.en: a decision I would have jumped at and would have an opportunity I would have jumped at.
sentences.zh: 一个我会毫不犹豫地接受的决定，一个我会毫不犹豫抓住的机会。

sentences.en: Like I said, when I think about the decision about making my application again in November, you know, we've got to do that process again.
sentences.zh: 就像我刚才说的，当我回想起11月再次提交申请的决定时，你知道，我们又得经历那个流程了。

sentences.en: And I think there's part of me that is still sort of like there's this kind of dream part of me of like, yeah, no, it'll be OK.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我内心深处仍然有某种部分在想，那种带着梦想色彩的部分在想：“对，没事的，会好的。”

sentences.en: You can you can apply to the four.
sentences.zh: “你可以把四个志愿都填了。”

sentences.en: You'll be all right.
sentences.zh: “你会没事的。”

sentences.en: It's definitely still like I absolutely acknowledge that part because there's so much positive experience I've had there.
sentences.zh: 这种想法绝对依然存在，我完全承认这一部分，因为我在那里有过太多美好的经历。

sentences.en: It's really difficult to ignore like the emotions and the experiences that I've had and the friends that are still there.
sentences.zh: 要忽视那些情感、那些经历以及那些至今仍在当地的朋友，真的是一件非常困难的事。

sentences.en: You know, those things that come with that decision as well as just, you know, I couldn't say a bad word about the interview process.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些伴随着那个决定而来的东西，再加上……你知道的，我对面试流程真的是挑不出半点毛病。

sentences.en: Liverpool are amazing.
sentences.zh: 利物浦真的太棒了。

sentences.en: Like if anyone's thinking about it, I would highly recommend.
sentences.zh: 如果有人正在考虑，我真的极力推荐。

sentences.en: It was very inclusive.
sentences.zh: 那里非常包容。

sentences.en: It was great.
sentences.zh: 真的很棒。

sentences.en: And, you know, all of that stuff is really important.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，所有这些因素都非常重要。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I'm honestly, if I'm being brutally honest, like I don't know what decision I'm going to make in November.
sentences.zh: 但是，说实话，如果我彻底坦白的话，我真的不知道自己在11月会做何决定。

sentences.en: I might still apply for Liverpool.
sentences.zh: 我可能还是会申请利物浦。

sentences.en: I might not.
sentences.zh: 也可能不会。

sentences.en: I think that's going to have to be communication, being open, seeing about where my kind of self-progression continues and where I'm at and what we're feeling.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这必须通过沟通来解决，要保持开放的心态，看看我个人的职业发展将走向何方，我目前处于什么状态，以及我们内心真实的感觉如何。

sentences.en: And having an open conversation before I put that down with my partner would be a really good starting point, I think.
sentences.zh: 而且在填报志愿之前，先和伴侣进行一次坦诚的交流，我觉得会是一个非常好的起点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And maybe, you know, starting to have those conversations early as well so that you can be excited about your choices as well, you know,
sentences.zh: 也许，你知道的，也要尽早开始这些对话，这样你才能对自己的选择感到兴奋，你知道的，

sentences.en: so that you can kind of put those eggs in that basket.
sentences.zh: 这样你就能把所有的希望都寄托在这个选项上了。

sentences.en: But I guess thinking about placements, you know, we apply for a university.
sentences.zh: 不过我想，说到实习安置，你知道的，我们申请的是一所大学。

sentences.en: And certainly in my mind, you know, I was moving to Coventry and so I thought, well, I'm going to live in Coventry.
sentences.zh: 而且在我的脑海里，当时我正要搬去考文垂，所以我想，“好吧，我要住在考文垂了”。

sentences.en: My university is in Coventry and my placements will obviously be in Coventry.
sentences.zh: “我的大学在考文垂，我的实习理所当然也会在考文垂。”

sentences.en: That is not the way universities work.
sentences.zh: 大学可不是这么运作的。

sentences.en: In my case, I was assigned a base, an employment base, which was not in Coventry.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，我被分配了一个工作基地，而那个基地根本不在考文垂。

sentences.en: And so that affected my mileage.
sentences.zh: 所以这直接影响了我的通勤里程补贴。

sentences.en: I was actually given Warwick, which meant that whenever I had placements, I couldn't claim any mileage until I'd already gone more than eight miles or whatever it was.
sentences.zh: 我当时被分到了华威，这意味着每当我需要去实习时，在我的行驶里程超过8英里（无论具体规定是多少）之前，我是无法申报任何交通补贴的。

sentences.en: And so, you know, that's 16 miles round trip.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，来回就是16英里。

sentences.en: And so that I was I was financing my placement mileage because I wasn't able to make those claiMs.
sentences.zh: 因此，我实际上是在自掏腰包补贴实习通勤费，因为我根本没办法报销。

sentences.en: But your placement might be kind of within an hour, maybe in some rural areas, within an hour or a half of university.
sentences.zh: 不过你的实习地点可能在车程一个小时之内，在某些乡村地区，可能在大学一个小时或半小时的车程范围内。

sentences.en: If you're already commuting, you know, they try to match you up fairly.
sentences.zh: 如果你本来就要通勤，你知道的，他们会尽量公平地为你匹配。

sentences.en: But sometimes you might be an hour and a half the other side from where you're living.
sentences.zh: 但有时你可能会被分配到你住处相反方向、车程一个半小时的地方。

sentences.en: And we really, really need to be able to think about, is this going to be sustainable for myself, for my well-being?
sentences.zh: 我们真的、真的必须去思考：这对我自己、对我的身心健康来说可持续吗？

sentences.en: You know, it may be if you have problems sitting for long periods of time in your car.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你本身有长时间坐车的问题的话。

sentences.en: Is this going to be sustainable for my physical health?
sentences.zh: 这会对我的身体健康造成可持续的负担吗？

sentences.en: You know, can I afford to bankroll all this fuel?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我负担得起承担所有这些油费吗？

sentences.en: Like, we really must begin to to slow down our reasoning process and not just get swept away with how exciting and how lovely it is to get this course over.
sentences.zh: 我们真的必须开始放慢我们的理性思考过程，不能仅仅被考上这个专业的兴奋和美好冲昏了头脑。

sentences.en: We've really got to think about this being three years of our lives, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们真的必须考虑到，这是我们生命中的三年，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I know some courses do part time options.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道有些课程提供非全日制选项。

sentences.en: It can be, you know, up to four years and three months of our lives.
sentences.zh: 那甚至可能是长达四年零三个月的生命时光。

sentences.en: Like, this isn't a short period of time.
sentences.zh: 你看，这不是一小段时间。

sentences.en: And we must not gaslight ourselves or honeymoon ourselves into thinking that it's only three years because that's a significant period of time, I think, Will.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不能自欺欺人，或者陷入“蜜月期”，觉得这只有三年，因为威尔，我觉得那是一段相当漫长的时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，绝对如此。

sentences.en: Scarily to think about that would be 10% of my lifetime right now.
sentences.zh: 可怕的是，一想到那居然占了我目前人生中的10%。

sentences.en: I think about spending away from, you know, my partner, from my life, you know, as we were saying in the intro, you know, I've born and bred in Devon and Somerset.
sentences.zh: 我想到要离开……你知道的，离开我的伴侣，离开我的生活——正如我们在开场白里说的那样，我是地地道道的德文郡和萨默塞特人。

sentences.en: So, you know, I had three wonderful years coincidentally, you know, in Liverpool and that being amazing.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我很巧合地在利物浦度过了美妙的三年，那段经历确实无比精彩。

sentences.en: But there is much more to life.
sentences.zh: 但生活远不止于此。

sentences.en: This is this really needs to be a holistic decision.
sentences.zh: 这真的必须是一个整体性的决定。

sentences.en: There is so much that goes into decisions around Declan.
sentences.zh: 围绕德克兰（译者注：此处可能为语音识别错误，指代决策过程）所做的决定涉及方方面面。

sentences.en: And it's not just about your career.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅关乎你的职业生涯。

sentences.en: It's about your relationships.
sentences.zh: 它关乎你的亲密关系。

sentences.en: It's about your well-being.
sentences.zh: 它关乎你的身心健康。

sentences.en: Although reflecting on that, I think there's a part of me that thinks I imagine there are some people who feel like it is just about the career.
sentences.zh: 尽管反思这一点时，我觉得我内心里有一部分会觉得，我猜有些人会觉得这真的只关乎职业生涯。

sentences.en: And maybe they haven't been able to think they haven't been forced into making a decision or they haven't, you know,
sentences.zh: 也许他们一直没能去思考，他们没有被迫做出过这样的决定，或者他们没有……

sentences.en: they don't want to think about it because they just think about it being a career.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不想去想这些，因为他们满脑子只想着这是一条职业道路。

sentences.en: And, you know, this I feel like in my situation, for me, this really has made me think, like, this has to be a holistic conversation because there is so much to do with, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我觉得在我的情况下对我而言，这真的让我开始思考：这必须是一次全盘考量的对话，因为这里面涉及太多东西，你知道的，

sentences.en: adaptations and moving and living and paying rent and, let's say,
sentences.zh: 比如适应环境、搬家、生活、付房租，还有，比方说，

sentences.en: fuel and your placements and your friends and your family and all these kind of bits that fit together as you and your life and what that means for you.
sentences.zh: 油费、实习、朋友、家人，以及所有这些交织在一起构成“你”和你的生活、以及这一切对你意味着什么的碎片。

sentences.en: And, you know, at the end of the day, this is, roughly speaking, a mental health course.
sentences.zh: 而且，归根结底，这大体上是一个心理健康相关的专业。

sentences.en: And it would be nice to think that we can also prioritise our own mental health in the making of these decisions and how we contribute then, I think, also to the course itself.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能在做这些决定时也优先考虑我们自己的心理健康，并思考我们随后将如何为课程本身做出贡献，那将是一件很美好的事。

sentences.en: You know, I want to be able to give my best self to a course.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我希望能把最好的自己奉献给一门课程。

sentences.en: And I'm not sure at this time going to Liverpool would have been my best, the best version of me that I could have put on that course.
sentences.zh: 我不确定在当时那种情况下，去利物浦会是我最好的状态，不是我能展现出的那个最好的自己。

sentences.en: And then that has its own ramifications, you know, itself may not have performed as well.
sentences.zh: 而这又会带来它自己的一系列后果，你知道的，自身的表现可能就不会那么好。

sentences.en: You know, maybe I fail a couple of assessments or something and, you know, you get kicked off like you don't know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，也许我有几门考核不及格什么的，然后，你知道的，你可能会被开除——你根本无从得知。

sentences.en: Or just maybe not, as you've spoken before, like that maybe I don't enjoy it as much.
sentences.zh: 或者就像你之前说的那样，也许我没有那么喜欢它。

sentences.en: Maybe you fall out of love with the work that you're doing.
sentences.zh: 也许你会对你正在从事的工作失去热情。

sentences.en: And I don't want to do that.
sentences.zh: 而我不想那样。

sentences.en: I don't believe that it would happen.
sentences.zh: 我不相信这种事会发生。

sentences.en: But to say that it could never happen would be silly, you know, and I want to love that.
sentences.zh: 但如果说这种事绝无可能发生，那就太愚蠢了，你知道的，我希望我能热爱它。

sentences.en: I want to enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 我希望能享受其中。

sentences.en: I want to be passionate.
sentences.zh: 我希望能充满激情。

sentences.en: And I can feel that, like, you know, in my current role, although my, you know, typical NHS fashion, my contract is up for renewal.
sentences.zh: 而我能真切地感受到这一点，就像在我的现职岗位上一样——尽管按照NHS的典型风格，我的合同快要到期续签了。

sentences.en: So that's obviously that's up in the air as well.
sentences.zh: 所以这显然也是个未知数。

sentences.en: But the idea of like being here and myself, I feel very much that this is me as a clinician and I'm able to bring that to my job.
sentences.zh: 但像这样身处这里、做回自己，我深刻地感觉到这就是身为临床医生的我，而且我能把这一点带入到我的工作中。

sentences.en: And I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: And I like being here and I'm, you know, working on myself.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢留在这里，而且，你知道的，我正在自我提升。

sentences.en: And those are all the things that I'm really happy to still have access to right now.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我非常高兴现在依然能够拥有的东西。

sentences.en: Good, good.
sentences.zh: 很好，很好。

sentences.en: And, you know, you may choose not to apply to Liverpool and that's OK.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你也可以选择不申请利物浦，那也没关系。

sentences.en: You may choose to apply to Liverpool, whatever happens.
sentences.zh: 不管发生什么，你也可以选择申请利物浦。

sentences.en: Liverpool can still be somewhere that you, you know, regard as an important place.
sentences.zh: 利物浦仍然可以是你，你知道的，把它当作一个重要地方的存在。

sentences.en: So my husband and I still like visiting Brighton and that will be always a special place because he lived there.
sentences.zh: 所以我和我丈夫依然喜欢去布赖顿旅游，那将永远是一个特殊的地方，因为他曾在那儿生活过。

sentences.en: And, you know, we can have mini breaks there and love that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们可以在那里度个短假，非常喜欢。

sentences.en: And yeah, like you can still have that in your life, but it might not necessarily be that you that you live there full time again.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像你的生活中依然可以有这些，但可能不一定非得是你再次全职住在那里。

sentences.en: I'm excited to see where your story goes and how it unfolds well.
sentences.zh: 我很期待看到你的故事走向何方，以及它将如何美妙地展开。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Yeah, me too.
sentences.zh: 对，我也是。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: Yeah, I've already signed up for the Liverpool Football Club tickets and stuff.
sentences.zh: 对，我已经注册了利物浦足球俱乐部的球票之类的东西。

sentences.en: So I'm looking to get tickets for this year.
sentences.zh: 所以我正打算买今年的门票。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I'm sure there'll be plenty of journeys up if I can.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果可以的话，我确信会有很多次过去的旅程。

sentences.en: So you want to be a season ticket holder?
sentences.zh: 所以你想成为季票持有者？

sentences.en: Not season ticket, just but like you've got the ballot systems now.
sentences.zh: 不是季票，只是现在有那种抽签系统。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: That was his whole own conversation.
sentences.zh: 那是他自己的长篇大论了。

sentences.en: But I've put in ballots for tickets.
sentences.zh: 不过我已经为门票进行了抽签登记。

sentences.en: So, yeah, for the first half of the season.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，为了上半个赛季。

sentences.en: So hopefully we'll see that come through.
sentences.zh: 所以希望我们能看到结果出来。

sentences.en: My boys are Spurs fans and they're always like, can we get tickets?
sentences.zh: 我的两个男孩是热刺球迷，他们总是问，我们能买到票吗？

sentences.en: Can we get tickets?
sentences.zh: 我们能买到票吗？

sentences.en: But it's so inaccessible because like you get the season ticket holders get first priority.
sentences.zh: 但太难买到了，因为季票持有者享有优先权。

sentences.en: And then, you know, it's just it's really it's not an easy thing to do.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，这真的不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: You know, it's a whole other episode, but it's not an easy thing to do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是另一集的话题了，但这确实不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: It is very expensive as well.
sentences.zh: 而且也非常贵。

sentences.en: It's not easy.
sentences.zh: 这不容易。

sentences.en: And it's also expensive.
sentences.zh: 而且还很贵。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: Is there anything we haven't said so far that you think would be useful for us to talk about before we finish?
sentences.zh: 在我们结束之前，还有没有什么我们没提到、你觉得对我们交流很有帮助的事情？

sentences.en: Well, one of the one of the prompts I was thinking about was this idea of having space for these kind of conversations in the profession.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想到的其中一个切入点是，在这一行业中为这类对话留出空间的这种理念。

sentences.en: I think that is a really important part of this conversation where I feel super lucky, super blessed to have had like supervisors who are like amazing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是这段对话中非常重要的一部分，我感到超级幸运，超级有福气能遇到像天使一样的督导。

sentences.en: Like I've loved my supervisors, like I've been incredibly lucky.
sentences.zh: 就像我非常喜欢我的督导一样，我真的极其幸运。

sentences.en: I'm also very aware that not everybody has that experience.
sentences.zh: 我也很清楚，并不是每个人都有这种经历。

sentences.en: But in terms of space for these conversations, I'm not sure that there is some of that space for these kind of conversations.
sentences.zh: 但就为这些对话留出空间而言，我不确定是否真的有足够空间来进行这类对话。

sentences.en: I've had people reach out to me via LinkedIn saying like, oh, like congratulations.
sentences.zh: 曾有人通过领英联系我，说，哦，祝贺你。

sentences.en: Like I made something sort of similar and, you know, and saying that, you know, their feedback hadn't been very positive.
sentences.zh: 就像我也做了一些类似的事情，然后，你知道的，说他们的反馈并不是很积极。

sentences.en: And I think that has been quite reflective also in my own personal life where I've had people being like, oh, like that doesn't seem like the right decision.
sentences.zh: 我想这也相当真实地反映在我的个人生活中，我曾遇到过有人说，哦，那似乎不是正确的决定。

sentences.en: That doesn't seem like a good thing.
sentences.zh: 那似乎不是一件好事。

sentences.en: I think the space for those conversations, when I was reflecting on that, I feel like that needs to be both bottom up and top down.
sentences.zh: 当我反思这一点时，我认为为这些对话留出空间，需要自下而上和自上而下双管齐下。

sentences.en: I think that needs to come both from ourselves as, you know, mental health practitioners, whether it be assistant psychologists, psychological well-being practitioners, whatever,
sentences.zh: 我认为这既需要我们作为精神健康从业者——无论是助理心理学家、心理健康从业者，还是其他什么身份——

sentences.en: to push for those conversations to be had.
sentences.zh: 去推动这些对话的展开。

sentences.en: I know we've got the infamous, you know, Facebook groups and everything, which for me is too much.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们有那些声名远扬的脸书群组之类的，对我和说这实在太多了。

sentences.en: I find that overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 我发现这让我应接不暇。

sentences.en: Not for me.
sentences.zh: 不适合我。

sentences.en: It's a lot of, there's a lot of difficulty on that for me personally in that way.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，这在某种程度上带来了很多困难。

sentences.en: But, you know, in terms of being in that space, that can be helpful for some people, but also thinking about bringing it into the workplace too, because this is, you know,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，就身处那个空间而言，这对某些人可能会有帮助，不过也要考虑把它带入工作场所，因为这是，你知道的，

sentences.en: I remember being in an office in my first, first role in forensics and in forensic hospital.
sentences.zh: 我记得在法医心理学领域的第一个职位、在法医医院的办公室里的情景。

sentences.en: And it was six APs in that office at that time, that week of feedback where nobody got any interviews was just, was just grim.
sentences.zh: 那时候办公室里有六个助理心理学家，那一周谁也没有拿到面试通知的反馈简直是糟透了。

sentences.en: It was grim.
sentences.zh: 简直糟透了。

sentences.en: It's not a nice experience.
sentences.zh: 这不是一段美好的经历。

sentences.en: And reflecting back on it, you know, now, like, yeah, we probably weren't ready and that's okay.
sentences.zh: 如今回想起来，现在，是的，我们可能还没准备好，那也没关系。

sentences.en: But ultimately thinking like, it's not, that experience is really difficult to have space for that.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底想一想，要为那种经历留出空间真的很困难。

sentences.en: It's a sense of loss.
sentences.zh: 这是一种失落感。

sentences.en: It's difficult comes with a lot of different emotions for different people might tug on, you know,
sentences.zh: 这很艰难，对不同的人来说会引发许多不同的情绪，可能会触动，你知道的，

sentences.en: there's core values of not being good enough of overthinking of whatever it might be that it might be, might be tugging on.
sentences.zh: 那种觉得自己不够好的核心价值观、过度思考，或者无论触动了什么。

sentences.en: And then that was the case for me.
sentences.zh: 而我当时的情况就是这样。

sentences.en: And to try and push to have those conversations, whether it be in supervision, whether it be peer to peer, whether it be whatever,
sentences.zh: 并努力去推动进行这些对话，无论是在督导中、同行之间，还是无论通过什么形式，

sentences.en: create that environment where we can have these kind of safe conversations about what that actually looks like and how that might impact, I don't know, our workload.
sentences.zh: 创造那种环境，让我们能够就这到底是什么样的、以及它可能会如何影响我们的工作量进行这种安全的对话。

sentences.en: It might be called talking about, I don't know, having some annual leave planned if you haven't got some planned already or thinking about what we can do to, you know,
sentences.zh: 可能是在谈论，我不知道，如果你还没计划的话，安排一些年假，或者考虑我们可以做些什么来，你知道的，

sentences.en: create a space where we're working towards being able to get that offer.
sentences.zh: 创造一个空间，让我们朝着能够获得那个录用通知的方向努力。

sentences.en: You know, the things that I need to work on and have that safe space to discuss that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我需要改进的地方，并拥有一个安全的空间来讨论这些。

sentences.en: And I know that that's, that was what really helped me when I was in those conversations.
sentences.zh: 我知道，正是在那些对话中，才真正帮助了我。

sentences.en: That would have, that would have really helped, I think, at that time.
sentences.zh: 我想，在那个时候，那真的会非常非常有帮助。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking about top down as well, is that I think supervisors, I think it'd be really helpful if supervisors are aware that I think of, of the impact.
sentences.zh: 而且我也在考虑自上而下的层面，我认为督导们，如果能意识到这些影响，将会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: I don't think there's many people that I've come across that aren't aware of how difficult this is and, you know, bringing that into their conversations.
sentences.zh: 据我接触过的人中，没有多少人会意识不到这有多困难，并且，你知道的，将这一点带入他们的谈话中。

sentences.en: But I think that is an important factor of like just being aware of like those, those dates and when people might be getting feedback and, and what might be happening.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这是一个重要的因素，那就是要意识到那些日期，以及人们可能什么时候会得到反馈，还有可能会发生什么。

sentences.en: And just being aware of some of those things, I think, could be a really good starting point, but also just recognising that at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 仅仅意识到其中一些事情，我认为就可以是一个非常好的起点，同时也要认识到归根结底，

sentences.en: we are human beings and experience a cyclical experience of loss and of failure.
sentences.zh: 我们都是人类，会经历失落和失败的周而复始。

sentences.en: In parentheses, like it's not actually failure, guys, don't worry, it's okay, there is another opportunity.
sentences.zh: 顺便括号说明一下，这其实并不是真正的失败，伙计们，别担心，没关系，还有其他机会。

sentences.en: But that experience, it brings up a lot of those emotions.
sentences.zh: 但那种经历确实会引发许多这样的情绪。

sentences.en: And I think making space for that is really, really important.
sentences.zh: 我认为为之留出空间真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: I know for me, in making the decision, after the decision, before the decision, talking it through with people, supervisors, friends, family, whatever,
sentences.zh: 我知道对我而言，在做决定时、决定做出后、决定做出前，与他人、督导、朋友、家人等倾诉，

sentences.en: was such a good way just to get stuff out on paper, just to talk, just to make sure you've processed, given it space and processed some of that stuff is really, really important.
sentences.zh: 真的是把事情诉诸纸端的好方法，只需交谈，只需确保你已经消化了、给它留出空间并处理其中的一些事情，真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: Yeah, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: And thank you for helping us to make space for that here.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你帮我们在这里为此留出空间。

sentences.en: And actually, what I know is that this podcast changes lives, well, people, because people get in contact and tell me that it has, not always when they watch it for the first time,
sentences.zh: 事实上，我所知道的是，这个播客改变了人们的生活，真的，因为人们会联系我并告诉我它确实做到了，虽然并不总是在他们第一次观看时，

sentences.en: but that it starts to percolate ideas through for them.
sentences.zh: 而是它开始为他们潜移默化地萌生出一些想法。

sentences.en: And actually, when it comes to key decision-making moments, it's stayed with them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当谈到关键的决策时刻时，它一直伴随着他们。

sentences.en: And actually, they think back of that as being a really pivotal moment.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们回想起那是一个非常关键的时刻。

sentences.en: And maybe even when people begin to fill in their forms in future, they will hold this in mind and really think about the impact of, you know,
sentences.zh: 甚至可能当人们在未来开始填写表格时，他们会把这一点铭记在心，并真正去思考，你知道的，

sentences.en: which Xs or which numbers they put in which boxes.
sentences.zh: 他们在哪个方框里打勾或填入哪个数字的影响。

sentences.en: And so thank you from me and from my audience for helping us have this conversation, because I think it's really important.
sentences.zh: 所以，我代表我和我的观众感谢你帮助我们开展这次对话，因为我认为这真的非常重要。

sentences.en: It's really powerful and it matters.
sentences.zh: 这非常有力量，而且意义重大。

sentences.en: Yeah, I couldn't agree more.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全赞同。

sentences.en: You know, we do experience, like I said, other people and myself, that kind of idea of this pedestal for the declin.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正如我所说，其他人包括我自己，确实都经历过那种把临床医生捧上神坛的想法。

sentences.en: And although it's something that I think we're all aspiring to, maybe not everyone who's in the audience, but I know a lot of people are aspiring to that.
sentences.zh: 尽管这是我认为我们所有人都在追求的，也许并非观众中的每个人，但我知道很多人都在为此奋斗。

sentences.en: And is it great?
sentences.zh: 这很棒吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: Is it everything in the world?
sentences.zh: 这就是全世界的一切吗？

sentences.en: No, it's not.
sentences.zh: 不，并不是。

sentences.en: And your holistic self, your authentic self, it's really important.
sentences.zh: 你完整的自我、真实的自我，才是真正重要的。

sentences.en: And like, I would encourage anybody to try and explore that as much as you can to bring that to your work.
sentences.zh: 而且，我会鼓励任何人尽可能去探索这一点，把它带入你的工作。

sentences.en: But also just your life, just like be you, keep doing you like that's what's important and make sure that you're happy and keep working on that because that's what we can do.
sentences.zh: 但同样还有你的生活，做你自己就好，继续保持自我，这才是最重要的，确保自己快乐并不断为之努力，因为这就是我们能做到的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time and for sharing your story with us, Will.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间与我们分享你的故事，威廉。

sentences.en: Wishing you the very best of luck and please do stay in touch.
sentences.zh: 祝你一切顺利，请务必保持联系。

sentences.en: Keep us posted.
sentences.zh: 随时向我们同步最新进展。

sentences.en: I will.
sentences.zh: 我会的。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you so much to our guest today, Will.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢我们今天的嘉宾威廉。

sentences.en: Thank you for watching.
sentences.zh: 感谢观看。

sentences.en: Thank you for tuning in.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: If you would like to offer Will some support, please let's get busy in the comments and let him know that we really value him spending his time speaking with us.
sentences.zh: 如果你想给威廉提供一些支持，请在评论区活跃起来，让他知道我们非常珍视他花时间与我们交谈。

sentences.en: If you love being a fly on the wall of people's real life stories in psychology,
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢像旁观者一样窥探心理学领域中人们的真实生活故事，

sentences.en: I think you will love the Clinical Psychologist Collective book and the Aspiring Psychologist Collective book too.
sentences.zh: 我想你也会喜欢《临床心理学家合集》这本书以及《有远大志向的心理学家合集》这本书。

sentences.en: They get wonderful reviews and they really do help people to make sense of their own careers whilst reading and learning about people's reflective growth and journeys in their careers.
sentences.zh: 它们获得了极佳的评价，在人们阅读和了解别人的职业反思成长与心路历程的同时，确实能帮助他们理清自己的职业生涯。

sentences.en: They are uplifting, energising at times deeply emotional reads and I think that you'll really enjoy them too.
sentences.zh: 这些读物令人振奋、充满活力，有时又深具情感共鸣，我想你也会非常喜欢的。

sentences.en: If you've already read them and not yet left a review on Amazon or Goodreads,
sentences.zh: 如果你已经读过它们，但还没在亚马逊或Goodreads上留下评价，

sentences.en: please do take a moment to do that because it really does help audiences to know that it's worth checking out.
sentences.zh: 请花一点时间去做这件事，因为这确实能帮助受众了解它是值得一读的。

sentences.en: And if psychology is a bit of you and it's your time and you're ready for the next step, please do check out the Aspiring Psychologist membership and the Ready to Rise program.
sentences.zh: 如果你对心理学情有独钟，觉得时机成熟且准备好迈出下一步，请务必查看“有远大志向的心理学家”会员资格和“准备崛起”项目。

sentences.en: Come and grab your free psychology success guide on my website www.aspiring-psychologiSt.co.uk
sentences.zh: 快来我的网站 www.aspiring-psychologist.co.uk 领取你的免费心理学成功指南。

sentences.en: There's also the free Aspiring Psychologist community on Facebook, which is run by me, Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 脸书上还有一个由我——玛丽安·特伦特博士运营的免费的“有远大志向的心理学家”社群。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正寻求成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有此播客一路相伴，你将在玛丽安·特伦特博士的“有远大志向的心理学家”播客指引下迈向成功。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Beth and I'm a psychological well-being practitioner from Newcastle.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫贝丝，我是来自纽卡斯尔的一名心理健康从业者。

sentences.en: I just wanted to say the biggest thank you to the contributors of the Clinical Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 我只想对《临床心理学家合集》这本书的撰稿人们表达由衷的感谢。

sentences.en: I've enjoyed reading this so much and loved having an insight into the range of backgrounds and experiences people have prior to applying for the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我非常享受阅读这本书，也很喜欢深入了解人们在申请博士学位之前所拥有的各种背景和经历。

sentences.en: And it's been really interesting seeing the potential barriers to the application as well and how I can try and work around this.
sentences.zh: 了解申请过程中潜在的障碍以及我该如何尝试绕过这些障碍，真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: I really started to doubt myself and whether I was good enough to apply for the Clinical Psychology doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我曾经开始怀疑自己，怀疑自己是否足够优秀去申请临床心理学博士学位。

sentences.en: But this has really given me the confidence boost that I needed to give it a shot.
sentences.zh: 但这确实给予了我所需要的自信心，让我去放手一试。

sentences.en: So the biggest thank you ever.
sentences.zh: 所以，致以最最诚挚的感谢。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱之外还能赚钱，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, Clinical Psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，我自2019年以来一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One to Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我本人于2022年完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的心路历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我个人的独家支持套餐，不收取任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森的精美礼品以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
